**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.**

This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes toolpath generation and posted G-code for the Bore operation.

This review is the build that the earlier read-only review on this head asked for ("not built - needs a maintainer look"). It replaces the `needs-maintainer` label with `needs-rework`. The notes of the earlier review stay valid.

Thank you for this work, @sn3ro. The design is clear and the tests are strong. Two items block the merge. Both are small.

## What looks good

- The helix rides the same wall circle as the ring ladder (`rc = R - r - leave`). It uses half-turn arcs, the same pattern as `thread_ride.rs`, so each arc posts as one G2/G3 with Z.
- `BoreParams::validate` refuses the two unsafe cases before any move is built: a core at the floor, and a helix steeper than 15 deg. Each message gives the value that fits.
- The move to the centre at the floor is safe, because the core door proves `rc <= floor reach`.
- Climb is CCW and conventional is CW. This agrees with the ring ladder.
- The project file stays compatible: `helical` and `spring_pass` are written only when true. An older file reads as Rings. The stamp does not change for a ring ladder.
- Detect holes skips and names the holes that one helix cannot clear.
- The MCP field list, the guide, the refusal reference and the decision record are all in the PR.
- No golden under `tests/golden/` moves. No snapshot PNG changes. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` in new non-test code. `bore_helix.rs` has its provenance comment.

## Results, merged with main (locally)

Trial merge: PR head `c70e84309` with upstream main `aa4c785db`. Git merges the text with no conflict. The merged tree does **not compile** (item 1 below).

Run with `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --only ...`, on the merged tree:

- `debug build: app (--no-run)`, `debug build: ui (--no-run)`: ok.
- Motion suites: 119 steps, 118 ok, 1 failed: `motion suites: equal_steps` (compile error, item 1). The other 118 include `bore_helix`, `bore_ramp_angle`, `center_cut_law`, `entry_ramp_angle`, `level_links`, `refusal_ghost`, `top_z_level` and `lib`.
- App suites, all ok: `lib`, `bore_helical`, `bore_entry`, `break_through`, `coarse_rims`, `hole_wall_flats`, `ladder_entry_height`, `mill2d_c`, `refusal_location`, `stepped_stock_rapid`, `stock_source_holes`, `stock_source_verdict`, `thread_mill_rim`, `mcp`, `mcp_provider`, `mcp_wire_contour`, `sinker_side`, `setup_align_hole_kinds`, `lathe_workholding_kinds`, `deburr_unreachable`.
- `ui suites: lib`: ok.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: failed on the same compile error.

I then added the one missing field locally (not pushed). With it, clippy is clean, and `equal_steps` and `bore_helix` pass.

Extra suites run: none were owed. The PR does not change `testdata/` or a fixture directory, and it does not change import code.

Heavy lanes: I did not run them again. The PR body says the motion and app heavy lanes ran on `c70e84309`: 231 steps, 0 failed. Please run them again after the merge of main.

### Mutations (run by the reviewer)

| Mutation in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/bore_helix.rs` | Result |
|---|---|
| M1: `helix_leaves_core` accepts `rc` up to two times the floor reach | red: `a_hole_one_helix_cannot_clear_is_refused_with_the_widest_it_can` (motion), `a_hole_too_wide_for_one_helix_is_refused_through_the_operation` (app), `detect_for_a_helical_bore_skips_the_holes_one_helix_cannot_clear` (app lib) |
| M2: no floor circle (the spring pass gives one circle) | red: `the_counterbore_is_one_helix_on_the_wall_then_a_floor_circle_and_never_a_plunge`, `the_spring_pass_is_a_second_floor_circle` |
| M3: `MAX_HELIX_ANGLE_DEG` 15 -> 45 | red: `a_helix_steeper_than_the_limit_is_refused_with_the_pitch_that_fits` |

All three mutations go red. The tests pin the safety doors well.

## Requested before merge

1. **The merge with current main does not compile.** Commit `9998a1c82` on main added a new `BoreParams` literal at `crates/motion/tests/equal_steps.rs:285`. It does not have the field `strategy`:
   ```
   error[E0063]: missing field `strategy` in initializer of `camcraft_motion::machining2d::BoreParams`
      --> crates/motion/tests/equal_steps.rs:285:17
   ```
   Fix: merge `upstream/main` into the branch (do not rebase). Add `strategy: Default::default(),` to that literal. Search the merged tree for other new `BoreParams {` and `OpParams::Bore {` literals. Then run the quick gate and clippy again.
2. **Add before/after screenshots to the PR body.** The PR changes `crates/ui/src/egui_app/holes_page.rs`: a new Strategy combo and a Spring pass check on the Passes tab, and the "Helix pitch" label on the Heights tab. Show the Passes tab with Rings and with Helical, and the Heights tab with Helical. Do not commit images to the tree. Put them on a separate images-only branch of your fork and link them from the body.

## Questions and notes (not blocking)

- **Non-centre-cutting tools on a small helix.** The plunge law (`plunge_law::first_solid_plunge_as`) sees only moves with no XY run. A helix always has XY run, so the law never stops it. When the hole is only a little larger than the tool, `rc` is small. Example: a 6.5 mm hole, a 6 mm tool and a 0.4 mm pitch give `rc = 0.25` mm and pass the 15 deg door. A non-centre-cutting tool then cannot cut the material under its centre. The other helix entries in the code have the same gap, so this is not new in this PR. A minimum `rc` for a tool that is not centre-cutting could be a follow-up issue.
- The default Bore stepdown (often 5 mm) is refused for the Helical strategy, as the body says. A clear message tells the user the pitch to type. That is acceptable. A seed pitch when the user selects Helical could be a later improvement.
- `crates/app/src/project/params.rs` (1799 lines), `params_impl.rs` (2660) and `operation/generate.rs` (4163) were already over the 400-line limit. Each grows by a few lines. This does not block.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
I set this PR to draft again. The review on c70e84309 asks for two changes, and a ready PR takes no pushes. I will push the changes, update the body and flag the PR ready again.

2. Screenshots: the PR body has a new "Screenshots" section. It shows the Passes tab and the Heights tab, each with Rings and with Helical.

Class: NEW CODE (a merge of main plus one test commit). The test commit changes only `crates/motion/tests/equal_steps.rs`.

Gates on 4bd091166:

- Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`): 724 steps, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` on the 8 touched crates: clean.
- Heavy lanes (`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`): 240 steps, 0 failed. The 6 known-fail steps (#1950, #2849) are red as expected.

Air cut: the air cut is not done yet. I can air-cut the counterbore case after the review.

Ready for a re-check.

Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The PR adds a Bore toolpath and changes posted G-code.

No collaborator review of this head existed when this local review started. A read-only review appeared while the local checks ran. This comment adds the local results and a new safety finding.

## Requested before merge

1. **[P1] Check the non-cutting core before a small helix enters solid stock.** See `crates/motion/src/machining2d/bore_helix.rs:67-103`.

   A local probe uses the stock block and the `NC` tool from `crates/app/tests/bore_helical.rs`. It sets the hole diameter to 6.5 mm and the pitch to 0.4 mm. `operation::generate` accepts the path with **zero warnings**: 51 moves and a 14.287 degree helix. The helix radius is only 0.25 mm.

   The existing `plunge_law::CORE` model (`crates/motion/src/plunge_law.rs:43`) uses half the tool radius as the non-cutting core. For this 6 mm tool, that radius is 1.5 mm. Under that model, a central radius of 1.25 mm remains inside the non-cutting area throughout the helix. The floor circle and the move to the centre do not clear it. The slope limit does not prove core clearance. The new validation never reads `p.links.approach.center_cutting`.

   [Sandvik's machining guide, page 107](https://cdn.sandvik.coromant.com/files/sitecollectiondocuments/downloads/global/technical%20guides/en-gb/c-2920-034.pdf#page=109) also requires a minimum hole diameter for non-centre-cutting cutters to prevent a remaining core.

   Check the non-cutting core against the helix radius. Refuse the operation unless the cutter clears the core or the stock is proven empty there. Add an operation-layer refusal test for the numbers above. Keep the legal centre-cutting case. A conservative refusal is sufficient when the available tool data cannot prove clearance.

   This finding replaces the earlier nonblocking note about small helices. It concerns the new Bore strategy's accepted path into solid stock. The temporary probe was removed.

## Earlier findings resolved

- The Bore literal in `crates/motion/tests/equal_steps.rs` has `strategy`. Its suite passes after the trial merge.
- The PR body links the Passes and Heights screenshots for Rings and Helical. The images load and show the requested controls. No image is added to the PR tree.

## Local results

Trial merge: head `4bd0911660b083c731f512ead1673c96fdc11901` with upstream main `a47c7ff222bfdb3d02e25718ba448f5ffe835136`. The merge has no conflict. No GitHub runner was used.

The selected quick gate ran 25 steps. Its 24 motion and app steps passed. The UI step passed on the later full runs below. The full 743-step plan was not completed.

|---|---|
| motion | `bore_carried_ramp` 2; `bore_helix` 7; `bore_ramp_angle` 2; `center_cut_law` 7; `entry_ramp_angle` 5; `equal_steps` 13; `level_links` 12; `refusal_ghost` 3; `top_z_level` 13 |
| app | `bore_entry` 4; `bore_helical` 4; `break_through` 12; `coarse_rims` 5; `hole_wall_flats` 5; `ladder_entry_height` 5; `mcp` 23; `mcp_provider` 9; `mcp_wire_contour` 7; `mill2d_c` 9; `refusal_location` 3; `stepped_stock_rapid` 8; `stock_source_holes` 9; `stock_source_verdict` 22; `thread_mill_rim` 13 |

- UI lib, from `crates/ui`: **1,428 passed, 0 failed, 7 ignored**, with one test thread. The full retry with eight test threads has the same result.
- The initial eight-thread UI run stopped with `signal: 11, SIGSEGV: invalid memory reference`. The cause is not established. The two later full runs passed.
- App lib, `operation::bore_reach::tests`: **4 passed, 0 failed**.
- Clippy on `camcraft-motion`, `camcraft-app` and `camcraft-ui`, with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`: **passed**.
- Light lane in release: `motion light: lib` and `motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel` both passed. Two steps, 0 failed.

An earlier broad gate was invalidated during recovery from overlapping interrupted processes and a damaged dependency cache. It is not a green gate result. The later selected checks used a fresh target with seeding disabled.

### Extra suites run

All three are covered: `stock_source_holes` (9 passed, above), `stock_deburr_part` (5 passed), and `stock_chamfer_added_part` (3 passed). No STEP fixture is added. No importer code changes, so the importer rule requires no additional suite.

### Heavy lanes and limits

I set this PR to draft again. The review on 4bd091166 has a P1 finding (the uncut core of a tool that is not centre-cutting), and the PR conflicts with `main`. A ready PR takes no pushes. I will push the fix and the merge of `main`, update the body and flag the PR ready again.

@sn3ro, we tried to help with the merge of `main` and the P1 finding, because the PR was idle. We stopped before any push. Nothing on your branch changed.

The merge has a design conflict, not only a text conflict. In `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` (`run_job_arms`), this PR passes the new Bore `strategy` to the generator. `main` (#3316, `pass_start`) changes the same call to apply a pass start. Someone must decide how a pass start applies to a helical bore (one helix to the floor). Possible choices: ignore it for Helical, or start the helix at the chosen side. That decision is yours (or the maintainer's).

The P1 finding is still open. The operation-layer test must show that a 6 mm tool that is not centre-cutting is refused for a 6.5 mm bore at 0.4 mm pitch in solid stock, and that the centre-cutting case still passes.

Related: #3832 (brenmarshall) also adds helical entry to Bore.

The review items on 4bd091166 are done. The new head is 6932f4022.

1. **[P1] The uncut core.** Commit c85bdd982 adds the check to `bore_helix::check`. A tool that is not centre-cutting has an uncut core of `plunge_law::CORE` of its radius. The helix is refused when its wall circle is nearer to the hole axis than that core (`rc < CORE * r`). The message names the helix radius, the core and the smallest hole that the tool helixes. Your probe (Ø6.5, Ø6 tool, 0.4 mm per turn, helix radius 0.25 mm) is now refused for the NC tool with "1.500 mm uncut core" and "9.000 mm". A centre-cutting tool keeps the small helix.
   - Pinned by `a_helix_inside_the_uncut_core_of_a_non_centre_cutting_tool_is_refused` (motion) and `a_small_helix_inside_the_uncut_core_is_refused_through_the_operation` (app, through `operation::generate`, with the CC case).
2. **Conflicts.** The branch merges `upstream/main` at 33597a2fb. The merge of 6cfc0a6d4 brought Pass starts at (#3360) to Bore. One helix for each hole has no ring order, so a Helical Bore refuses Inside and Outside by name, at the command and in the generator. The Passes tab shows the refusal. Pinned by `a_helical_bore_refuses_a_pass_order_by_name`, `a_helical_bore_with_a_pass_order_is_refused_by_name` and the ui test `a_helical_bore_says_the_pass_start_refusal`.

Gates on 6932f4022:

- Quick: 809 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
- Clippy `--no-deps --all-targets` on motion, app and ui: clean.
- Heavy: 104 steps, 1 failed: `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm` (`the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`). It is a 3D Pocket test. It fails at the mesh pin: the STEP mesh has 5232 facets, not 6228. `Cargo.lock`, `crates/kernel` and `testdata` are the same as `main`. #3886 reports this step red on `main`.

Class: NEW CODE (one fix commit and merges of `main`). The PR body has the new Gates and Pinning tests. The PR stays a draft until a re-check.

@mkinney, thank you for the help. Your comment came before my push. The new head 6932f4022 has the merge of `main` and the P1 fix. My re-check comment above gives the details.

**Pass starts at on a Helical Bore.** I chose a third option: a Helical Bore refuses Inside and Outside by name, and Auto is unchanged.

- One helix for each hole has no ring order. Thus there is nothing for Inside or Outside to change.
- If the option is ignored, the user sets a value that does nothing, and no message tells them. The project rules do not permit a silent change.
- To start the helix at a chosen side is a different feature (a start point on the wall). It is not what Pass starts at means for the rings.
- The command refuses the combination first (`sane.rs`). The generator refuses it again (`bore_started`). The Passes tab shows the refusal under the row.

If the maintainer prefers a different choice, I will change it.

**The P1 test.** `a_small_helix_inside_the_uncut_core_is_refused_through_the_operation` (in `crates/app/tests/bore_helical.rs`) uses your numbers through `operation::generate`: a solid 60 x 60 x 20 stock, a Ø6.5 bore, a 0.4 mm pitch and a Ø6 tool. The tool that is not centre-cutting is refused. The centre-cutting tool cuts the small helix with no plunge.

**Overlap with #3832.** #3832 adds a helical entry to the ring ladder (the `entry` field). This PR adds a helical strategy that cuts the full hole with one helix (the `strategy` field). The two PRs change `OpParams::Bore` and the Bore generator. Thus the second PR to merge will have conflicts. Please tell us which design to keep, or if the two can stay together. If necessary, I can adapt this PR to the `entry` field of #3832.

Merged main to resolve conflicts. The new head is a2915de5b (a merge of `upstream/main` at aef12fe; no rebase, no force-push). It still merges cleanly with `main` at 034e91b8b.

Conflicts, both sides kept:
- `crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs`: the Bore flag rows `helical` and `spring_pass` (#2830), then the `minimum_cone_radius` row and the `kind_fields::complete` call from `main` (#3153, #3449). `complete` skips a row that is already in the list, so each flag shows one time. It marks the two flags `optional`.
- `crates/app/src/operation/params/holes.rs`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/holes_page.rs`, `crates/app/tests/break_through.rs`: the Bore `strategy` field (#2830) and the Bore `picks` field from `main` (#3339).
- `crates/app/src/operation/types/sane.rs`: the helical pass-start refusal (#2830) and the Chamfer2D tip offset check from `main` (#3153).

Two hand edits. Git merged these files without a conflict, but each initializer did not have the field of the other side:
- `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared/hole_order.rs` (from `main`): `strategy: Default::default()`. The default is Rings, so the test checks the same toolpath as before.
- `crates/app/tests/bore_helical.rs` (this PR): `picks: Default::default()`.

The merge has hand edits, so it is a DELTA: please do a delta review of `git show --remerge-diff a2915de5b`.

Targeted gate on a2915de5b. The quick gate map selects about 800 suites for this diff, so I ran the suites of the conflicted files and the pinning tests of the PR:
- `camcraft-app` lib: 314 passed.
- 26 app suites, all green. These include `bore_helical`, `bore_entry`, `bore_pass_start`, `break_through`, `start_exit_shared`, `chamfer_minimum_radius`, `mcp`, `mcp_compact`, `mcp_chamfer_minimum_radius`, `golden_cl`, `stock_source_verdict` and `thread_mill_rim`.
- `camcraft-motion` lib: 697 passed, 22 ignored (heavy lanes). `bore_helix` and `circular_helix_rings`: green.
- `camcraft-ui` lib: 1687 passed.
- `cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-ui -- -D warnings`: clean.

Not run: the heavy lanes. On `main`, `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm` is red for a different cause (#3886).

Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check). I cannot change labels, so `conflicts` and `needs-rework` are still on the PR. The review items of the last round are answered in my comment of 06:54 UTC today.

Reviewer: m3 pool job team2 review-3103, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: the code is clean. The PR conflicts with `main` again. Label: `conflicts`.**

This is a SAFETY-tier re-review. The PR adds a Bore toolpath and changes posted G-code.

## Earlier findings (review on 4bd091166)

1. **[P1] Uncut core of a tool that is not centre-cutting: fixed.**
   - Commit c85bdd982 adds the check in `crates/motion/src/machining2d/bore_helix.rs:115-138`.
   - The helix is refused when `rc + CORE_TOL < CORE * r` and the tool is not centre-cutting. The smallest hole is `d + 2*leave + CORE*d`. This agrees with the check: Ø6 tool, no leave, gives Ø9.
   - The operation-layer test `a_small_helix_inside_the_uncut_core_is_refused_through_the_operation` uses the numbers of the earlier probe (Ø6.5, Ø6 tool, 0.4 mm pitch). The tool that is not centre-cutting is refused. The centre-cutting tool keeps the helix.
   - Mutation M1 below makes the motion test and the app test red.
2. **Conflicts with `main` (4bd091166): fixed at that time.** The merges up to a2915de5b resolve them. A new conflict came later (see below).
3. **Pass starts at on a Helical Bore (comment of 2026-11-25 05:45): answered.** A Helical Bore refuses Inside and Outside by name, at the command (`sane.rs`) and in the generator (`bore_started`). Auto is unchanged. No silent ignore. Mutation M2 below makes the two pinning tests red.

## Delta review of `git show --remerge-diff a2915de5b`

The author asked for it. Each hunk keeps the two sides:

- `crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs`: the Bore flag rows, then `kind_fields::complete`. Correct.
- `crates/app/src/operation/params/holes.rs`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/holes_page.rs`: `strategy`, `pass_start` and `picks: _`. Correct.
- `crates/app/src/operation/types/sane.rs`: the Bore refusal arm and the Chamfer2D guard arm. Correct.
- The two hand edits add `strategy: Default::default()` and `picks: Default::default()`. The default is Rings, so `hole_order` tests the same path.

No logic is lost. No safety rule is lost.

## New conflict with `main` (not a code finding)

`main` merged #3832 (`15b3fa142`, Bore entry by plunge, ramp or helix) after this head. A trial merge of a2915de5b with upstream/main `f0bdc5109` stops with conflicts in:

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/holes_page.rs`: the Bore destructure (`strategy` against `entry`), and the Lead-in tab (the helical hint against `lead_page::bore_entry_group`).
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`: the `mod bore_strategy;` and `mod bore_entry_group;` lines.

This is a design overlap, not only a text overlap. `OpParams::Bore` now has the field `entry`. The author must decide what a Ramp or Helix `entry` does on a Helical strategy. Do not ignore it silently. A refusal by name (the same pattern as Pass starts at) agrees with the rest of this PR. The generator, the `sane.rs` check, the stamp and the project file need the same decision. Each Bore literal also needs the other field.

After the merge of `main`, the PR needs a delta review of that merge.

## Local results

The PR head a2915de5b was built and tested in `.claude/worktrees/review-3103` on macOS (arm64). The trial merge with the current main conflicts, so the tests ran on the PR head, which merges main at `aef12fea6`. No GitHub runner was used.

### Mutations run by the reviewer

|---|---|
| M1: disable the uncut-core check in `bore_helix::check` | Red: `a_helix_inside_the_uncut_core_of_a_non_centre_cutting_tool_is_refused` (motion) and `a_small_helix_inside_the_uncut_core_is_refused_through_the_operation` (app) |
| M2: remove the pass-start refusal in `bore_started` | Red: `a_helical_bore_refuses_a_pass_order_by_name` (motion) and `a_helical_bore_with_a_pass_order_is_refused_by_name` (app) |
| Restore the source | Green |

### Goldens moved

None. The diff changes no `*.nc`, `*.cl`, `examples/catalog/**`, `testdata/` or snapshot PNG.

### Extra suites run

- No `testdata/` change. No importer change. No extra suite is required by those rules.
- The changed `stock_source_holes_support` helper: `stock_source_holes` passed (above).

### Heavy lanes

Not run. AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review" does not require them for this P6 PR. The author reports `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm` red on main, tracked by #3886.

## Screenshots

The PR body has before and after screenshots of the Passes and Heights tabs, for Rings and Helical. The images are on the `pr-screenshots` branch of the fork. No image is in the PR tree. The new pass-start refusal line has a UI test and no screenshot. That is sufficient.

## Optional, non-blocking

- AGENTS.md **New tests join a directory suite** (#3187): `crates/app/tests/bore_helical.rs` and `crates/motion/tests/bore_helix.rs` are new top-level test binaries. Move them into a directory suite (for example a `bore` suite), or add a one-line reason to the PR body. You can do this in the same push as the merge of `main`.

## Next step

Merge `upstream/main` into the branch. Decide the `entry` on a Helical strategy. Run the targeted gate and comment "ready for a re-check".

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
